# `get_current_img`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Image socket: return the latest live/preview frame as image bytes.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (scratch file on the compressed raw path; 64-bit build, 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager binary image table (serves 4800/4804), handler @0x116cb0 (64-bit build), @0xa6dec (32-bit build); static analysis of app 3.3.2, MainFileManager.getCurrentPic; copy into a request-local IMG_DATA (IMG_DATA::operator=), shouldTransferJpg/convertImageToJpg, zip compression of raw output, reponse_result; param strings compress and img_type; JPEG path, convertImageToJpg passes an empty target path to IMG_DATA::ToJPG, whose imwrite/Save branches run only for a non-empty path (CFG check, 64-bit build); raw path, IMG_DATA::Compress @0x6a2d10 (64-bit) / @0x67236c (32-bit), WriteFile of a scratch file, run_popen of a zip command, ReadFile, remove |

Image-socket (4800/4804) method. Returns the current preview frame. Optional params: `compress` (boolean, default true) and `img_type` (`"Raw"` forces raw output). Under a lock the handler copies the shared current-image buffer into a request-local buffer, releases the lock, and sends it: JPEG (imgType 4) in Jpg mode unless `img_type` is `"Raw"`; otherwise raw, zip-compressed (dataType 3) when `compress` is true and plain (dataType 2) when it is false. With no frame available the reply is the error text `there is no image now`. READ. It fetches an already-captured frame; it does not trigger an exposure or write shared state. Zip-compressed raw output goes through a temporary scratch file on device storage, so under the strict convention it is a MUTATOR with observation-safe (tier B) effects. The 32-bit build matches (READ), apart from log wording and image-library version. Firmware 9.75 (64-bit): when the preview setting raw_bin2 is true, raw 16-bit Bayer (imgType 1) and RGB48 (imgType 5) frames on the non-JPEG path are binned 2x2 before sending; the header width, height and bytes 20 to 23 are halved and imgType is unchanged (READ; 32-bit not checked).

Side effects: Reads the shared current-image buffer under a mutex into a request-local buffer, optionally converting it to JPEG or zip-compressing it, then responds with the bytes. No capture is triggered and no shared state is mutated. READ; the 32-bit build matches (READ). JPEG conversion encodes in memory: the conversion routine writes a file only when it is given a target path, and this handler passes none. READ (64-bit build; the 32-bit build has the same call structure, READ). When `compress` is true on the raw path: zip compression of raw output writes the raw bytes to a fixed-name scratch file in the imager's private data directory, runs an external zip compressor on it, reads the archive back and deletes both files before replying. READ. Nothing persists, so the effect is observation-safe (tier B), but the handler is a MUTATOR under the strict convention, as for get_server_log. Because the scratch name is fixed, two compressed raw requests served at the same time could interfere; INFERRED.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_current_img"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | no | - | Optional. The app sends no params member. `img_type` "Raw" forces raw output; without it the image transfer mode decides (Jpg gives JPEG). [READ] |
| `params.compress` | boolean | no | true | Zip-compress raw output (dataType 3); false sends plain raw (dataType 2). Default true. [READ] |
| `params.img_type` | string | no | - | "Raw" forces raw output even in Jpg mode. [READ] |
